title: Opening of reel 1: names, date and the Jazz Life book
summary: Interviewer and Sal Gutierrez sort out the tape, names (Salvador Edward Gutierrez), the date 15 January 1970, and that Sal's picture is in Berendt's Jazz Life.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I'm going to play something. And they had some people from West Germany, and they recorded the one thing. And I was supposed to get one of the records and all that, and a little magazine from West Germany, which I never get from Joe, you know, from Joe Moran.

I may have that in a book, man. I may have your picture in a book, I might. From Germany. Was Pinky playing too much? Yeah. I think I have a picture of that. And you had a woman singing gospel songs? Right. Yeah. How is it, Betty? Is it a machine worker?
Who's the loudest? Me and him? Speak again. Okay, say something, Sal. What's your name? Sal Guterres. He's got a little stronger than you are. That's good. What's your right name?

And in Salvador? Well, in Nashville, in Salvador. You got a middle name? Edward. Salvador Edward Gutierrez. Oh, what's today's date, by the way? We ought to have that down on the table. January the… 14th or 15th. Wait a minute, it's on my watch. If I can see my eyes up there. 15th. 1970. I always forget what year it is in January. I got to do it myself. Anyway, your picture is in that book called Jazz Life by… one of the guys' name was Joachim Ernst Berendt. They called him Joe, the guy with glasses.
